affected_subject.reason: StakingManager reward distribution and dynamic HYPE/kHYPE exchange ratio are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Staking large HYPE just before ValidatorManager injects rewards is a concrete trigger.

direct_effect.reason: Attacker mints more kHYPE then withdraws for more HYPE than staked, capturing unearned rewards.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected fair reward proportional to staking vs actual timing-based capture; numeric exchange-ratio example supports relation.

summary: Report identifies StakingManager exchange-ratio mechanism, front-run staking trigger, concrete profit effect, and fairness/numeric basis sufficient to attempt formalization.
